messages:
alex: Heads-up — after rolling the new allocator on staging I see steady memory growth on long-context generation jobs (~50k tokens). Worker: staging-worker-7. Roughly +1.2GB every 10k tokens, fragmentation ratio creeping up. Anyone seen this pattern before?

maria: Can you dump jemalloc/tenant stats? also pmap + top while running would help.

alex: Yep, attaching quick output snippet: 
```
# top + pmap snapshot
PID  TID  RSS   VIRT
1234     3.8G  12G
jemalloc stats:  arenas: 4 active,  fragmented: 1.31
```

kv-bot: Auto compaction triggered on staging-worker-7 at 6169991170 — reclaimed 230MB, frag_ratio=1.28, compactions=2 :information_source:

sanjay: My immediate suspicion is micro-block churn with the 128B bin size we flipped this morning. Long contexts produce many small KV writes; allocator ends up scattering lots of tiny live/ dead slots. Try bumping kvcache.block_size to 256 or 512 in a canary.

elaine: FYI I ran a quick canary: switched block_size=256 + minor compaction every 30s. Memory growth slowed but CPU in compactor spiked ~15%. p99 latency for short requests rose ~8ms. So it's a tradeoff.

alex: Thanks. Do you have the compaction config you used?

elaine: config snippet: 
```
kvcache:
  block_size: 256
  compaction:
    mode: minor
    interval_seconds: 30
    target_reclaim_ratio: 0.2
```

maria: Another angle: instead of aggressive minor compacts, experiment with incremental coalescing only on idle or when fragmentation crosses 1.5. That should reduce CPU side-effects. Also consider adaptive binning: keep 128B for hot short keys, but aggregate long-context allocations into a separate arena with larger slab sizes.

sanjay: +1 to arena separation. We can add a per-tenant 'longctx' pool routed by request metadata (sequence length > X). That isolates churn. Implementation-wise: allocate a second kvcache arena and route large contexts there; compaction thresholds can be laxer for longctx pool.

alex: Nice. For short-term mitigation: 1) roll block_size=256 on a single cell, 2) set compaction interval to 45s and only run when frag_ratio > 1.4, 3) add a metric to flag per-arena churn.

kv-bot: Created ticket RK-9823: "staging long-context kvcache fragmentation — canary experiments" and scheduled nightly compaction run at 3:00 UTC for canary pool.

elaine: I'll run a controlled A/B tomorrow with metrics (rss, frag_ratio, compactor_cpu, p99) and post results.

alex: Awesome — assign to @sanjay and @elaine. If A/B looks good we can push to dedicated pool routing. :thumbsup:
